title: Girl hit by car becomes ball of light
content:
I got hit by a car when I was 12. When the paramedics got there, I was DOA. I split my head open. They brought me back with the paddles.

I remember seeing the car coming at me, then a flying sense. Very vivid. I noticed flying because the car hit me and then I was flying into transitioning.

Then I went through a tunnel/portal and everything was bright. I knew what was going on, but I was not scared. I looked down at myself, and I was a ball of light. That didn't scare me either. I was happy and floating around.

Then I saw figures and there were lots of voices speaking but I couldn't understand. Then something grabbed me from behind me and said something else I couldn't understand. When I realized I wasn't a ball of light anymore, I was already waking up in the ambulance.

I felt uncontrollable anger.
